title: Pdb or Not to Be: Comparing Debugging Interfaces With Pass$_{X}$@$k$
abstract: arXiv:2611.08666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive debuggers are indispensable to human software development, yet coding agents overwhelmingly rely on edit-execute-observe loops, using common bash tools, test scripts, and print statements to debug via repeated shell commands. Stepping through a debugger provides live access to runtime state, which may enable different problem-solving capabilities. However, prior work typically introduces the debugger as an additional tool or through a new subagent, making its individual contribution difficult to isolate from the associated scaffold changes. To address this, we compare a debugger-only agent against a bash-only agent on all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances, holding the rest of the scaffold fixed. We evaluate both architectures on two models, GPT-OSS-120B and Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B, with three independent runs per architecture $\times$ model configuration. translated_title: Pdb 抑或不 Pdb：使用 Pass$_X$@$k$ 比较调试接口
translated_abstract: 交互式调试器对人类软件开发而言不可或缺，然而编程智能体却压倒性地依赖“编辑-执行-观察”循环，借助常见的 bash 工具、测试脚本和打印语句，通过反复执行 shell 命令来进行调试。使用调试器单步执行可以实时访问运行时状态，这可能带来不同的问题求解能力。然而，先前的工作通常将调试器作为附加工具或通过新的子智能体引入，这使得其自身的贡献难以从伴随的脚手架改动中分离出来。为解决这一问题，我们在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 实例上，将仅使用调试器的智能体与仅使用 bash 的智能体进行对比，同时保持脚手架的其余部分固定不变。我们在两个模型（GPT-OSS-120B 和 Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B）上评估这两种架构，每个“架构 × 模型”配置进行三次独立运行。关键的是，为了区分接口专业化与覆盖范围的扩大……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在固定其余脚手架的前提下，通过 Pass$_X$@$k$ 指标在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 实例上对比“仅调试器智能体”与“仅 bash 智能体”，首次隔离量化了调试器接口本身对编程智能体的贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper isolates the contribution of the debugger interface itself by comparing a debugger-only agent against a bash-only agent with the rest of the scaffold fixed across all 500 SWE-bench Verified instances, using the Pass$_X$@$k$ metric.
